I replied to Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-team: the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

Both sources are things Marcus can see himself. Dana wrote in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 during the morning shift. The North cheat sheet, a public file, also lists Thea as QFL's main contact.
